in_hebrew.name: זבולן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Zebulen is derived from the Hebrew words 'zev' (abundance, riches) and 'bul' (house, dwelling). The name can be translated as 'Habitation of God' or 'God's abundance.' It is a name that reflects the idea of God's presence and provision in one's life.

in_greek.name: Ζεβουλών
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Zebulen in Greek is derived from the words 'zeus' (god) and 'boulos' (strength, counsel). The name can be translated as 'God is my strength' or 'God's counsel.' It is a name that conveys a sense of divine protection and guidance.

in_latin.name: Zebulon

biblical_reference.note: Zebulen is mentioned in the Old Testament as a son of Ham and grandson of Noah. He is also mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Jacob.

This name serves as a reminder to put our trust in God and to seek His guidance and protection in all aspects of our lives. It is a name that inspires us to live in a way that honors and glorifies God, and to strive to live up to the name's meaning of being sublime or exalted in His sight.
